name: gift_of_paradise_enchanted_land_taps_for_two_of_one_color
notes: Printed: 'Enchant land. When this Aura enters, you gain 3 life. Enchanted land has "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."' P0 casts Gift of Paradise on its Forest (gains 3: 23). Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The Forest's own {T}: Add {G} cannot pay Metropolis Sprite's {1}{U}; its granted ability, two blue, pays it exactly: the Sprite enters and the Forest taps. Until 2026-11-17 the payer read a permanent's first mana ability only, so the granted one never paid on a basic land.
